title: SponsoredReportTarget::request is an Option used as a sent flag inside SponsoredReportFlow::Asking
trigger: Report an ad: Asking with request None until the send leaves
effect: Asking(request None) means not sent, Asking(Some) means out; a failed send relies on dismiss() being called by the caller to leave; the error arm compares target.request == Some(id) only
fix: Choosing(target) and Asking(target, RequestId) as separate variants

title: getStarAdAccountUrl failure is dropped silently and the url is a bare Option with no stage
trigger: open a channel or bot Stars page; the AdAccountUrl request fails or answers empty
effect: EarnPurpose::AdAccountUrl error arm is {}; page.ad_account_url stays None so the Buy Ads row never shows and nothing can say asked/failed/none; the answer is matched by peer only
fix: Fetch<Option<String>> keyed by RequestId on the page

title: Earn TonStats/StarStats/AdAccountUrl answers and errors are matched by peer only; Load::Loading holds no request id
trigger: Open a revenue page, refresh (or reopen the same peer) while the first stats request is out; the older one fails
effect: apply_earn_error sets page.stars/page.ton to Failed over a Ready value from the newer request and toasts the error; an older answer overwrites a newer one
fix: Load<T> carries the request id; settle only for it

title: CollectionsFetch has no Failed stage and no request id; an error settles to Idle like an answer
trigger: getGiftCollections fails on open
effect: Idle after an error is indistinguishable from never asked: no Retry, no error shown, tabs silently missing; any answer (even another owner's same-owner older one) settles Loading
fix: Fetch<Vec<GiftCollection>> with request id

title: Giveaway option answers are matched by chat id or purpose, not by the RequestId held in the Fetch
trigger: Open the giveaway form, change chat or reopen quickly so two getPremium/StarGiveawayOptions are out
effect: apply_star_giveaway_options and apply_giveaway_error for stars call succeed/fail_dropping_data without a request check, so an older answer overwrites the newer fetch; premium is matched only by for_chat
fix: Fetch::answered/failed with the request id

title: GiveawayLaunch::Launching holds the request as raw u64 with 0 meaning none
trigger: A launch whose request id is recorded before the send (request 0)
effect: Every match writes request != 0; same 0 sentinel in gift_market.rs (pending.map_or(0, ..) fed to waits_for(request)) so a missing pending can match a stage that holds id 0
fix: Option<RequestId>/RequestId in the variant; never pass 0 for no request

title: The checkout is five fields kept in step by hand: request, checkout, order_info, shipping_id, note
trigger: Buy on an invoice, Continue, close, or Buy another invoice
effect: close_checkout (checkout.rs:11), start_invoice_checkout (ui/invoice_checkout.rs:53-58, resets 4 of the 5 directly on the session) and the PaymentForm answer (apply.rs:40-43) each reset a different subset; a form fetch error leaves request Some while checkout is Closed so payments.shows() stays true
fix: One Checkout enum/struct owning invoice, form stage, order info, shipping and note, replaced whole

title: One-shot slots nothing but the UI poll clears: unlocked_notice, receipt_error, verification_url, note
trigger: Payment verification or receipt failure while the poll does not run for that window (locked/other window)
effect: verification_url written over by a second payment before the first is opened; Verifying stage has no drain of its own (doc says nothing drains it) and only a checkout close leaves it
fix: Route through PaymentsState::notices queue and give Verifying its own exit

title: Sessions, connected websites, storage statistics, account TTL, default auto-delete and saved sounds answers and errors are matched by purpose only, not by the request id Fetch::Loading can hold
trigger: Press Refresh twice, or refetch after a terminate while an earlier getActiveSessions is still out
effect: The older answer succeed()s or the older error fail()s over the newer fetch (apply_settings_error GetActiveSessions/GetConnectedWebsites/GetStorageStatistics/GetAccountTtl call fail without a request check)
fix: Fetch::answered(id)/failed(id) at each site

title: BusinessSettingsState::saving is a Vec of setting kinds cleared by kind, not by request id; error is one shared slot
trigger: Save the same Business setting twice quickly (second send while the first is out)
effect: The first answer or error removes the kind while the second request is still out, so the screen re-enables the control early; the shared error slot is also written by chat links, chatbot and ads failures (business_extra.rs:258)
fix: saving: Vec<(kind, RequestId)> removed by id; per-screen errors

title: Saving indicator is a Vec of setting kinds, answered by kind not RequestId
trigger: Leave Greeting (save 1), reopen it, change, leave (save 2); answer 1 arrives
effect: apply_business_ok/error retain-out every entry of that kind, so Saving... goes while save 2 is still out, and a refusal of save 1 is shown as the current one
fix: Vec<(RequestId, kind)> or a per-kind SaveStage::Saving(RequestId) matched on the answer's id

title: BotLookup holds three Options (exact: Option<Option<i64>>, mine, global) as per-leg arrived flags; done() is all three Some
trigger: Type a chatbot username on the Business chatbots screen
effect: Each leg's stage is None/Some; a failed leg is recorded as Some(empty) (apply_business_extra_error) so a refused search reads as an answered empty result and the box says no results instead of an error
fix: A Leg enum per part (Asking(request), Found(..), Failed) like SearchState's Leg

title: Save answers write Fetch::Idle over a connected_bot fetch that may be in flight; save_connected_bot also writes Ready over it
trigger: Leave Chatbots with a change (save sent, Ready(bot)); ok lands (Idle); re-enter (fetch R in flight); change and leave again (Ready(bot2) over Loading) then R answers with the older server value
effect: connected_bot shows the old bot (or Idle) after the second save until the next visit refetches
fix: Keep the Loading request id in the stage and only apply the answer whose id is current; a save answer should not rewrite Fetch

title: A failed setOption(language_pack_id) or synchronizeLanguagePack is swallowed
trigger: Switch the interface language while TDLib refuses the setOption or the synchronize
effect: apply_language_error ignores SetOption and Synchronize: the strings fetch can still install the pack in the UI while TDLib keeps the old language option, and no SwitchFailed event is queued
fix: Make SetOption and Synchronize part of the switch stage (a request id in Fetching) so their error leaves it with SwitchFailed

title: sending and changing are shadow copies of the request registry, pruned lazily at the next send
trigger: A quick reply send or change whose request is lost (logout sweep, dropped continuation)
effect: Entries stay until the next send_quick_reply_request retains by registry; the answer and error arms never remove them, so the maps are correct only after the next call prunes them
fix: Ask the registry (has_purpose with the key) instead of mirroring it, or remove on answer/error

title: scope_settings_loading HashSet is a loading flag by scope kept in step by hand with scope_notification_settings and the request registry
trigger: Open Notifications settings while getScopeNotificationSettings fails or an update lands first
effect: The set is inserted in connect, removed in apply (answer), apply_error, send failure and UpdateScopeNotificationSettings; a failed fetch leaves neither Failed nor data, so the defaults silently read as unknown and nothing shows an error
fix: HashMap<Scope, Fetch<ScopeNotificationSettings>>

title: baseline: SettingsState::pending_attention
trigger: A notification-worthy message arrives while the notifier does not run (locked, logged out, other window)
effect: The one-shot bool is set by the reducer (session_apply_messages.rs:479) and drained only by notify_accounts.rs:225 take; allowed with a reason in implicit-state-allow.txt and still in the baseline (four lines), so the register keeps it
fix: A queued AttentionEvent drained by the notifier, or remove from the baseline lines (duplicate entries) once the allow entry stands

title: data_storage_dirty is a reducer-written, driver-cleared persist flag; auto_download_answer is a one-shot slot
trigger: The presets answer seeds data_storage; the driver persists on the next ingest; two saves answer before the UI takes the slot
effect: data_storage_dirty stays set if the driver never ingests (locked/hidden) or the write fails; auto_download_answer holds only the newest answer so an earlier editor misses its Saved/Refused
fix: A persist command queue, and a per-request answer map consumed by the editor that sent it

title: Attached Stickers box: attached_request + attached_answer + sticker_set_view(loading 0) are three fields moved in step by connect/stickers.rs
trigger: fetch_attached_sticker_sets sets all three; apply/error clear two of them
effect: None today; a one-shot answer slot is read by open_attached_sticker_set with take()
fix: one enum AttachedSets { Idle, Asked(RequestId), Answered(Option<i64>) } or put the stage into StickerSetViewStage

title: ManagerCommit::sent is never cleared after the answer; in-flight is also derived by scanning requests.pending (manager_change_pending)
trigger: advance_manager_commit sets front.sent = Some(id), answers do not clear it
effect: None today; note_commit_failure matches the old id only, but a step taken off by next_step on a failed send leaves failure set until the UI clears it (note_send_failure is also called twice per failure)
fix: CommitStage { Idle, Sent(RequestId) , Failed } on ManagerCommit

title: archived_has_more and archived_next_offset change together beside the archived Fetch; finish_mask_mutation resets all three by hand
trigger: accept_archived_mask_sets writes has_more+offset then succeed; finish_mask_mutation clears them separately
effect: None today
fix: one ArchivedMasks paging value inside the Fetch data

title: active_reactions and active_emoji_reactions are two copies of updateActiveEmojiReactions written together
trigger: apply.rs:23-24 writes both; ui/reactions.rs reads one, session_group_admin.rs the other
effect: None today; a writer that updates one copy leaves the other stale
fix: one field

title: Stale-mark bools (reaction_options_stale, creator_refetch_sets, StickerPanel recent/favorites/trending_stale, GifPanel::stale) are hand-cleared refetch stages beside their Fetch lists
trigger: set by updates, cleared by connect/stickers.rs and sticker_creator.rs after the send
effect: None today; each owner clears its own bool, a new reader must know the order (send, then clear)
fix: Fetch::Outdated per list (outdate() on update, wants_fetch() in the driver)

title: StoryAvailableReactions answer with any other purpose (or none) is stored into the story picker's available_reactions
trigger: A StoryAvailableReactions payload that is not GetMessageAvailableReactions arrives (stale or update-like); else-branch writes it
effect: Picker options replaced by an answer that was not asked for the story; options are also not keyed by story
fix: gate the else-branch on RequestPurpose::GetStoryAvailableReactions and hold it as Fetch<Vec<..>> with a RequestId

title: getForumTopics answer is matched by purpose and chat id, not by a RequestId; CreateForumTopic removes the list while an older request is in flight
trigger: Chat list asks a forum's topics, user creates a topic (list removed), the older getForumTopics answer lands
effect: Stale topic list without the new topic is inserted as Ready; the chat list never asks again
fix: Fetch::sent(request) in ForumTopicsMap::begin and answered(request, ..); CreateForumTopic uses outdate()

title: getCloseFriends answer sets Ready without matching the RequestId held in CloseFriendsList::Loading (section 8 05-166 skip says the load is matched; only the failure is)
trigger: Open close friends (getCloseFriends in flight), save a new list (setCloseFriends ok sets Ready(ids)), then the older getCloseFriends answer lands
effect: The just-saved close friends list is overwritten by the older server list until reopened
fix: CloseFriendsList::answered(request, ids) that only takes the answer of the Loading request, as fail_load does for the error

title: Contacts invalidation resets Fetch to Idle by hand at six sites instead of Fetch::outdate
trigger: Add/remove/import/clear contacts (users/apply.rs 261, 278; session_apply_ok.rs 784, 791, 825, 829)
effect: The list blanks under a spinner, an in-flight getContacts stays in requests (has_purpose blocks the refetch until its answer is dropped), the 'refetch owed' is implied by Idle
fix: self.users_state.contacts.outdate() (Fetch::Outdated) at every site, one refetch owner

title: SaveWatch::take_outcome takes a caller-supplied in_flight bool beside SaveAnswer::Waiting (two sources of truth for 'still in flight': the watch and requests.pending)
trigger: A watched profile request is dropped without an answer; the caller must pass in_flight=false from requests.pending to get Unknown
effect: A caller that passes the wrong in_flight keeps a box in Saving or claims Saved; no stage of the box holds the request
fix: the profile box's own Saving(RequestId) stage settled by the answer, the error or the request leaving flight (no second flag)
